attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Physical Therapy (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Professional development requirement (PDR) activities in the R 338.7163 table: approved CE related to PT practice (approved regardless of format if approved/offered by APTA or its components, FSBPT, another state PT board, accredited PT programs etc.), postgraduate academic courses, journal articles with evaluation, educational media (0.5 credit per 30 min), presenting CE, peer-reviewed exhibits/papers, authoring articles/chapters, ABPTS specialty certification, residency/fellowship, committees, guest/clinical instruction (3 credits per 40 h), experiential activities, volunteer work, FSBPT self-review tool. Max 12 credits of online CE in one 24-hour period; no credit for repeating an equivalent program in the same cycle.
rules.audit_note: Submitting the renewal application certifies compliance; keep documentation 4 years after renewal. The department may audit. Waiver requests at least 30 days before the last Board meeting before expiry.

topics.who: All licensees: at least 1 PDR credit in pain and symptom management via a CE program (MCL 333.16204(2))
All licensees: 1 hour per year of the license cycle (R 338.7004); counts toward the 36 PDR credits; no carry-forward
All licensees and applicants: one-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking meeting R 338.7126 standards

rules.notes: Physical therapy licenses renew every 3 years on the issue date (R 338.7002). PDR credits are earned in the 3 years before expiration. Rules amended effective March 5, 2026 (2026 MR 5). Board website (michigan.gov) blocked our automated check; figures taken from the Administrative Code.
rules.rule_quote: …shall accumulate PDR credits in activities approved under these rules during the 3 years immediately before the expiration date of the license, as follows: (a) Not less than 36 PDR credits if the applicant for license renewal is a physical therapist. (b) Not less than 24 PDR credits if the applicant for license renewal is a physical therapist assistant.
